indices.name: S&P 500
indices.note: Lost about 148 points, a sixth straight losing day.

indices.name: Nasdaq
indices.note: Dropped about 551 points as chip and AI stocks sold off.

indices.name: Dow
indices.note: Fell about 1,101 points, slipping back below 50,000.

notes: Stocks opened higher, then turned sharply lower in the afternoon as talk of further Fed rate hikes and stretched valuations spread selling across almost every sector; only energy and staples ended up.
Anthropic debuted on Nasdaq after pricing at $83, opened near $111.50, then faded to close around $97, still up about 17% on its first day.
Chipmakers led the slide: AMD fell nearly 8% after a short-seller report on China ties, and Nvidia lost over 3% despite strong results; the VIX jumped about 14% to near 28.
events: Fri 20 Nov: monthly options expiration day on US exchanges.
Thu 26 Nov: US markets closed for Thanksgiving; Fri 27 Nov closes early, at 21:00 Kuwait time.
Wed 9 Dec, 22:00 Kuwait time: Federal Reserve rate decision, with a hike under debate.

sources.title: Motley Fool: Dow plunges 1,100 points as S&P 500 falls a 6th straight day
